crossRefs.note: You have declared today that Yahweh is your God, and that you would walk in his ways, keep his statutes, his…
Your own mouth condemns you, and not I. Yes, your own lips testify against you.
“He said to him, ‘Out of your own mouth I will judge you, you wicked servant! You knew that I am an exacting man…
I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.
but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.”

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: Joshua said to the people, “You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen Yahweh yourselves, to serve him.” They said, “We are witnesses.”
translations.bsb: Then Joshua told them, “You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen to serve the LORD.” “We are witnesses!” they said.
translations.kjv: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye are witnesses against yourselves that ye have chosen you the LORD, to serve him. And they said, We are witnesses.
translations.asv: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye are witnesses against yourselves that ye have chosen you Jehovah, to serve him. And they said, We are witnesses.
